source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 27ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Αλύπιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It gives one sentence of life, a couplet, and no year, no place and no hymn. Its glossary note on the name lists two other Alypii — a fourth-century architect of Antioch and a fourth-century Greek writer on music — as bearers of the name and not as this martyr.
